lessons: Koyal is useful as additional evidence and often recovers clear source vocabulary and grammatical forms.
The 160 disagreements with other automatic labels are not 160 proven errors; many are orthography, numbers, minor recognition errors or added speech.

The 22 timestamp-crossing flags are diagnostics; many arise from merged ASR words rather than proven clipping errors.

The exact printed-row cut proposals preserve all 941 source entries and meanings. Their 761 candidate matches still require waveform/listening checks; the other 180 are unresolved, not proof of missing audio or textbook mistakes.
Check true printed-text errors separately against the source edition and language evidence. Preserve loanword/historical spelling differences unless a correction is established.
